# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(R.utils)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing GEX count matrixes

GEX count matrices generated by CellRanger will now be imported:  
  
```{r}
sample_list <- list()
all_samples <- list.files(Input_data, full.names = TRUE)

# Create pattern to match samples of interest
pattern <- paste0("(", paste(c("VA025_T5", "VA038_T5", "VA059_T5"), collapse = "|"), ")")
samples_of_interest <- all_samples[grepl(pattern, all_samples)]

for (n in 1:length(samples_of_interest)) {
  sample_list[[basename(samples_of_interest[[n]])]] <- samples_of_interest[[n]]
}
```

```{r}
GEX_count_matrices <- list()
sample_names <- c()

for (sample in names(sample_list)) {
  dir <- sample_list[[sample]]
  sample_names[[sample]] <- sample
  GEX_count_matrices[[sample]] <- Seurat::Read10X(data.dir = dir)[['Gene Expression']]
  rm(dir)
}
```

# 3. Add unique identifier to each sample GEX matrix

Prior aggregation, cells across the various samples are named the same

```{r}
head(colnames(GEX_count_matrices[[1]]))
```

To avoid this, we remove the final characters '-1' and add a unique sample identifier

```{r}
for (count.mat in names(GEX_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(GEX_count_matrices))
  updated_barcodes_names <- paste(paste(substring(colnames(GEX_count_matrices[[count.mat]]),0,16),sep=""),'__', sample_names[index], sep = "")
  colnames(GEX_count_matrices[[count.mat]]) <- updated_barcodes_names
  
}
```

We can now confirm that the above step went well

```{r}
head(colnames(GEX_count_matrices[[1]]))
```

# 4. Setting up Seurat and SCE objects

We will now use these matrices to generate individual Seurat objects.
  
```{r}
for (count.mat in names(GEX_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(GEX_count_matrices))
  
  # Extract the sample name as character (not list)
  sample_name <- as.character(sample_names[index])
  
  str_dynamic_variable <- paste0('Sample.', sample_name, '.SeuratObj')
  
  seurat_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]] <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = GEX_count_matrices[[count.mat]], 
    project = sample_name
  )
  
  seurat_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]]$Identity <- sample_name
  seurat_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]]$Donor <- sub("_.*", "", sample_name)
}
```

# 5. Removing empty droplets

First we apply a very basic filtering to make sure to only retain barcode of emulsion that contain cells. The idea is to filter the least possible at this stage.

```{r}
for (count.mat in names(GEX_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(GEX_count_matrices))
  sample_name <- as.character(sample_names[index])
  str_dynamic_variable <- paste0('Sample.', sample_name, '.SeuratObj')
  seurat_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]] <- subset(seurat_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]], subset = nFeature_RNA >= 200)

}
```

We should here sample CellBender to ensure we are removing background. The output of cellranger count produces a raw .h5 file that is used as the input for remove-background. remove-background should be sample on a dataset as a pre-processing step, before any downstream analysis using Seurat, scanpy, your own custom analysis, etc.

# 6. Merging Seurat Objects

Now you would merge (not integrate or batch correct) the individual seurat objects

```{r}
# Ensure the 'Donor' column is explicitly added to metadata for each Seurat object
for (i in seq_along(seurat_objects)) {
  seurat_objects[[i]]$Donor <- seurat_objects[[i]]@meta.data$Donor
}

# Merge Seurat objects
if (length(seurat_objects) == 1) {
  # If there is only one Seurat object, use it directly
  Merged.SeuratObj <- seurat_objects[[1]]
} else {
  # If there are multiple Seurat objects, merge them
  Merged.SeuratObj <- seurat_objects[[1]]
  
  for (i in 2:length(seurat_objects)) {
    Merged.SeuratObj <- merge(x = Merged.SeuratObj,
                               y = seurat_objects[[i]],
                               project = "SARS-COV2_B")
  }
}
```

# 7. Removing doublets

```{r}
# Calculate the number of cells before doublet removal
number_cells_predblremoval <- table(Merged.SeuratObj$Identity)

# Initialize lists and variables
SCE_objects <- list()
passing_barcodes <- c()

# Normalize and scale the data
Merged.SeuratObj <- NormalizeData(Merged.SeuratObj)
Merged.SeuratObj <- ScaleData(Merged.SeuratObj)

donors <- unique(sub("_.*", "", sample_names))

# Iterate through the samples in the sample list
for (d in donors) {
      
      set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
      
      # Create a dynamic variable name
      str_dynamic_variable <- paste0('Donor_', sample, '.SCEObj')
      
      # Subset the Seurat object for the current sample
      SCE_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]] <- as.SingleCellExperiment(
        subset(x = Merged.SeuratObj, 
               cells = rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data[Merged.SeuratObj$Donor == d,]))
      )
      
      # Run scDblFinder to identify doublets
      SCE_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]] <- scDblFinder(SCE_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]])
      
      # Collect passing barcodes (singlets)
      passing_barcodes <- c(passing_barcodes,
                            colnames(SCE_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]])[
                              SCE_objects[[str_dynamic_variable]]$scDblFinder.class == 'singlet'
                            ])
}

number_cells_predblremoval <- table(Merged.SeuratObj$Identity)

# Subset the Seurat object to keep only passing barcodes
Merged.SeuratObj <- subset(Merged.SeuratObj, cells = passing_barcodes)

# Calculate the number of cells after doublet removal
number_cells_postdblremoval <- table(Merged.SeuratObj$Identity)

# Initialize a data frame to store the number of cells at different stages
df_number_of_cells <- data.frame(row.names = c('Start', 'Doublet_filtering'))

# Populate the data frame with cell counts
for (experiment in names(sample_list)) {
  for (lane in names(sample_list[[experiment]])) {
    for (sample in sample_list[[experiment]][[lane]]) {
      
      # Create a unique identifier for the sample
      id <- paste0('Sample_', sample)
      
      # Populate the data frame
      df_number_of_cells['Start', id] <- number_cells_predblremoval[[sample]]
      df_number_of_cells['Doublet_filtering', id] <- number_cells_postdblremoval[[sample]]
    }
  }
}

# Write the data frame to a CSV file
write.csv(df_number_of_cells, 
          file = file.path(results_folder, '/QC/S1146_L364D', 'Number_of_cells_pre_post_dbl_removal.csv'), 
          row.names = TRUE, 
          quote = FALSE)
```

# 8. Setting up SCE object for QC metrics and gene filtering. 
    
```{r}
Merged.SCEObj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(Merged.SeuratObj)
Merged.SCEObj

# Metadata are also transferred

colnames(colData(Merged.SCEObj))
```

We now compute and add some additional metadata

```{r}
Merged.SCEObj$Barcode <- colnames(Merged.SCEObj)

rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$Symbol <- rownames(Merged.SCEObj)

rowData(Merged.SCEObj) <- cbind(rowData(Merged.SCEObj), perFeatureQCMetrics(Merged.SCEObj, detection_limit = 0))

rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$n_cells_by_counts <- rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$detected/100 * ncol(Merged.SCEObj)

rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$pct_dropout <- 100 - rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$detected
```

# 9. Global filtering

## - Genes filtering

We can now filter genes for which cells have very few counts

First we see the impact of different cutoff based on the averaged reads count

```{r}
# gene counts for both cut offs
ave.counts <- rowData(Merged.SCEObj)$mean

keepA <- ave.counts >= 0.005
keepB <- ave.counts >= 0.01
keepC <- ave.counts >= 0.02
keepD <- ave.counts >= 0.03

print(paste0('Log10 av count >=0.005 leaves ',as.character(sum(keepA)), ' genes '))
print(paste0('Log10 av count >=0.01 leaves ',as.character(sum(keepB)), ' genes '))
print(paste0('Log10 av count >=0.02 leaves ',as.character(sum(keepC)), ' genes '))
print(paste0('Log10 av count >=0.03 leaves ',as.character(sum(keepD)), ' genes '))
```

Then we look at the distribution of log 10 of the averaged reads count 

```{r fig.height = 5, fig.width = 8, fig.align = "center"}
# plot of both cut offs
options(repr.plot.width=8, repr.plot.height=6)

png(filename = paste(results_folder, '/QC/S1146_L364D', '/Gene_expression.png', sep = ''), 
    units = 'in', width = 12, height = 5, res = 300, type = 'cairo')
hist(log10(ave.counts), breaks=100, main="", col="grey80",
     xlab=expression(Log[10]~"average count"))
abline(v=log10(0.03), col="purple", lwd=2, lty=2)
text(log10(0.03),900, "0.03")
abline(v=log10(0.02), col="blue", lwd=2, lty=2)
text(log10(0.02),1050, "0.02")
abline(v=log10(0.01), col="red", lwd=2, lty=2)
text(log10(0.01), 1200, "0.01")
abline(v=log10(0.005), col="yellow", lwd=2, lty=2)
text(log10(0.005),1350, "0.005")
dev.off()
```

Then, based on the above we perform gene filtering using the best fitted threshold. In this case 0.005. The output will be an array of genes passing the threshold

```{r}
ave.counts <- rowMeans(counts(Merged.SCEObj))
keep <- ave.counts >= 0.005
print(paste0('Log10 av count adjustment now leaves ',as.character(sum(keep)), ' genes '))
#sum(keep)
```

Finally we filter the SCE object to only keep genes that passed the above threshold.

```{r}
Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered <- Merged.SCEObj[keep,]
Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered
```

## - Cell Filtering

We will now perform cell filtering based on the QC Metrics data.
We will first check where do threshold falls if we would happen to apply filtering on all cells taken as a whole.

It seems like there is some variability across samples. Applying a single treshold for all of the samples would not work in this case.  
For each parameter we want to filter, we will need to calculate individual tresholds to apply on each individual sample.


# 10. Individual samples filtering

```{r}
cells_sample <- list()

for (d in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  cells_sample[[d]] <- Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered[,rownames(as.data.frame(colData(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered)) %>% filter(Identity == d))]
  
}
```

## - Set unique reads filtering threshold

```{r fig.height = 5, fig.width = 8, fig.align = "center"}
options(repr.plot.width=10, repr.plot.height=6)

lower_cut_off_reads_sample <- list()
upper_cut_off_reads_sample <- list()
figures <- list()

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  index <- match(i,unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))
  
  lower_mad <- attr(isOutlier(cells_sample[[index]]$sum, nmads=2.4, type="lower", log=TRUE), 'thresholds')[1]
  fixed_lower_threshold <- 650
  
  higher_mad <- attr(isOutlier(cells_sample[[index]]$sum, nmads=2.4, type="higher", log=TRUE), 'thresholds')[2]
  fixed_higher_threshold <- 17000
  
  lower_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]] <- max(lower_mad, fixed_lower_threshold)
  upper_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]] <- min(higher_mad, fixed_higher_threshold)
  
  data <- data.frame(x=log10(cells_sample[[index]]$sum), 
                     Identity = cells_sample[[index]]$Identity)
  
  figures[[i]] <- ggplot(data,
                        aes(x = x, fill = as.factor(Identity))) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log10(lower_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]]), 
               colour="grey", linetype = "longdash") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log10(upper_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]]), 
               colour="grey", linetype = "longdash") +
    labs(x = expression('log'[10]*'(Library Size)'), title = "Total reads density", fill = "Ident") + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Identity", values = gg_color_hue(length(unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)))[index])
  
} 

combined_plot_reads <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = figures, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = 'h')

# Get the number of unique subpopulations
num_subpopulations <- length(unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))

# Calculate the number of chunks of 4 subpopulations
num_chunks <- ceiling(num_subpopulations / 4)

if (num_chunks == 1) {
  # If there is only one chunk, save the combined_plot_reads directly
  filename <- file.path(results_folder, 'QC/S1146_L364D', 
                          sprintf('Threshold_reads_donor_subpopulation_%d_to_%d.png', 
                                  start_subpopulation, end_subpopulation))
  png(filename = filename, width = 12, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 300, type = "cairo")
  print(combined_plot_reads)
  dev.off()
} else {
  # Loop over the chunks
  for (i in seq_len(num_chunks)) {
    # Calculate the start and end subpopulation for this chunk
    start_subpopulation <- (i - 1) * 4 + 1
    end_subpopulation <- min(i * 4, num_subpopulations)

    # Create the filename for this chunk
    filename <- file.path(results_folder, 'QC/S1146_L364D', 
                          sprintf('Threshold_reads_donor_subpopulation_%d_to_%d.png', 
                                  start_subpopulation, end_subpopulation))

    # Check if the plot exists for this chunk
    if (!is.null(combined_plot_reads[[as.character(i)]])) {
      # Save the plot to the file
      png(filename = filename, width = 12, height = 6, units = 'in', res = 300, type = "cairo")
      print(combined_plot_reads[[as.character(i)]])
      dev.off()
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("No plot found for chunk %d (subpopulations %d to %d)", 
                      i, start_subpopulation, end_subpopulation))
    }
  }
}
```

## - Set unique genes filtering threshold

```{r fig.height = 5, fig.width = 8, fig.align = "center"}
options(repr.plot.width=10, repr.plot.height=6)

lower_cut_off_genes_sample <- list()
upper_cut_off_genes_sample <- list()
figures <- list()

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  index <- match(i,unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))
  
  lower_mad <- attr(isOutlier(cells_sample[[index]]$detected, nmads=2.4, type="lower", log=TRUE), 'thresholds')[1]
  fixed_lower_threshold <- 350
  
  higher_mad <- attr(isOutlier(cells_sample[[index]]$detected, nmads=2.4, type="higher", log=TRUE), 'thresholds')[2]
  fixed_higher_threshold <- 3700
  
  lower_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]] <- max(lower_mad, fixed_lower_threshold)
  upper_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]] <- min(higher_mad, fixed_higher_threshold)
  
  data <- data.frame(x=log10(cells_sample[[index]]$detected), 
                     Identity = cells_sample[[index]]$Identity)
  
  figures[[i]] <- ggplot(data,
                        aes(x = x, fill = as.factor(Identity))) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log10(lower_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]]), colour="grey", linetype = "longdash") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log10(upper_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]]), colour="grey", linetype = "longdash") +
    labs(x = expression('log'[10]*'(Library Size)'), title = "Total genes density", fill = "Ident") + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Identity", values = gg_color_hue(length(unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)))[index])
  
}

} else {

    # Calculate the start and end subpopulation for this chunk

    end_subpopulation <- min(i * 4, num_subpopulations)
```

## - Filtering

We will now process to filter out the unwanted cells.
      
```{r}
libsize.drop <- list()
feature.drop <- list()
mito.drop <- list()

SCE_objects <- list()
SCE_objects.filtered <- list()

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  SCE_objects[[i]] <- Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered[,colnames(cells_sample[[i]])]
  
}

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {

  libsize.drop[[i]] <- grep('TRUE', cells_sample[[i]]$sum >= lower_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]] & cells_sample[[i]]$sum <= upper_cut_off_reads_sample[[i]])
  feature.drop[[i]] <- grep('TRUE', cells_sample[[i]]$detected >= lower_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]] & cells_sample[[i]]$detected <= upper_cut_off_genes_sample[[i]])
  mito.drop[[i]] <- grep('TRUE',cells_sample[[i]]$subsets_Mt_percent <= 9)
  
}

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  SCE_objects.filtered[[i]] <- SCE_objects[[i]][,intersect(libsize.drop[[i]],
                                                           intersect(mito.drop[[i]], feature.drop[[i]]))]
  
}

cells_to_keep <- c()

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  index <- match(i, unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))

  cells_to_keep <- c(cells_to_keep, colnames(SCE_objects.filtered[[i]]))
  
}

Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered.cells_filtered <- Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered[,cells_to_keep]

# Export number of cells pre and post filtering

print(paste0("Total cells before quality filtering = ",dim(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered)[2]))
print(paste0('Total cells before quality filtering, per sample:'))
table(colData(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered)$Identity)

print(paste0("Total cells remaining after quality filtering = ",dim(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered.cells_filtered)[2]))
print(paste0('Total cells after quality filtering, per sample:'))
table(colData(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered.cells_filtered)$Identity)

df_number_of_cells <- data.frame(row.names = c('Before_filtering', 'After_filtering'))

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  index <- match(i, unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))

  df_number_of_cells['Before_filtering', i] <- ncol(SCE_objects[[i]])
  df_number_of_cells['After_filtering', i] <- ncol(SCE_objects.filtered[[i]])
  
}

write.csv(df_number_of_cells, file = paste(results_folder, '/QC/S1146_L364D/Number_of_cells_pre_post_filtering.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T, quote = F)

# Export qc metrics pre and post filtering

df_qc <- data.frame()

for (i in unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity)) {
  
  index <- match(i, unique(Merged.SCEObj.genes_filtered$Identity))

  df_qc[i, 'Before_filtering__medianUMI'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects[[i]])$sum)[[3]]
  df_qc[i, 'After_filtering__medianUMI'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects.filtered[[i]])$sum)[[3]]
  df_qc[i, 'Before_filtering__medianGenes'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects[[i]])$detected)[[3]]
  df_qc[i, 'After_filtering__medianGenes'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects.filtered[[i]])$detected)[[3]]
  df_qc[i, 'Before_filtering__medianMT'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects[[i]])$subsets_Mt_percent)[[3]]
  df_qc[i, 'After_filtering__medianMT'] <- summary(colData(SCE_objects.filtered[[i]])$subsets_Mt_percent)[[3]]
  
}

write.csv(df_qc, file = paste(results_folder, '/QC/S1146_L364D/QC_pre_post_filtering.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T, quote = F)
```
